mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) increases amantadine renal clearance while amantadine may potentiate aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through additive effects on renal and eighth cranial nerve function.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN), hearing, and balance regularly; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; adjust amantadine dosing based on renal function; maintain adequate hydration.
